Definition: from G4655; to obscure (literally or figuratively):--darken.
BiblicalUsage: Skotizo means to darken, and it darkens the sun itself. Immediately after the tribulation the sun shall be darkened and the moon shall not give her light, and Paul says the foolish heart of man was darkened because, knowing God, they glorified Him not as God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the darkening of the sun is the sign of the end, and the darkening of the heart is the sign of a man who knew God and would not thank Him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
